answer: New identities enter through a narrow inlet: before any paid work, each must complete several low-value jobs, a hidden fraction of which are audit traps with known correct outcomes. A newcomer's answers form a signal - correct traps build standing, while lockstep or wrong answers across identities expose a farm and burn its bond. Real work is the nectar, reachable only after the trap signal clears; running a hundred fakes then means solving a hundred distinct audits honestly, with one slip staining the whole cluster.
